sources.title: Broncos odds of winning AFC West would skyrocket with win vs. Chiefs
sources.description: According to the New York Times simulator, the Denver Broncos odds of winning the AFC West jump to 49% if they beat the Kansas City Chiefs but plummet to just 14% with a loss.
